1: // Minimal Neon Asteroid Dodge game
2: // Assumes a <canvas id="game"></canvas> in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // Set canvas size to fill its CSS dimensions or default 800x600
8:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   const width = canvas.width;
12:   const height = canvas.height;
13: 
14:   // Player ship
15:   const ship = {
16:     w: 40,
17:     h: 20,
18:     x: width / 2 - 20,
19:     y: height - 40,
20:     speed: 5,
21:     color: '#0ff',
22:   };
23: 
24:   // Stars for background
25:   const stars = Array.from({ length: 100 }, () => ({
26:     x: Math.random() * width,
27:     y: Math.random() * height,
28:     z: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
29:   }));
30: 
31:   const asteroids = [];
32:   let lastAsteroid = 0;
33:   const asteroidInterval = 800; // ms
34:   let score = 0;
35:   let startTime = performance.now();
36:   let gameOver = false;
37: 
38:   const keys = {};
39:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
40:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
41: 
42:   function drawShip() {
43:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.color;
44:     ctx.beginPath();
45:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y);
46:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y - ship.h);
47:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y);
48:     ctx.closePath();
49:     ctx.fill();
50:   }
51: 
52:   function spawnAsteroid() {
53:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
54:     asteroids.push({
55:       x: Math.random() * (width - size),
56:       y: -size,
57:       w: size,
58:       h: size,
59:       speed: Math.random() * 2 + 2,
60:       color: '#f0f',
61:     });
62:   }
63: 
64:   function drawAsteroids() {
65:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f0f';
66:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
67:       ctx.fillRect(a.x, a.y, a.w, a.h);
68:     });
69:   }
70: 
71:   function updateAsteroids(delta) {
72:     asteroids.forEach(a => (a.y += a.speed * (delta / 16)));
73:     // Remove off‑screen
74:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
75:       if (asteroids[i].y > height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
76:     }
77:   }
78: 
79:   function drawStars() {
80:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
81:     stars.forEach(s => {
82:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.z, s.z);
83:       s.y += s.z * 0.5;
84:       if (s.y > height) {
85:         s.x = Math.random() * width;
86:         s.y = 0;
87:         s.z = Math.random() * 2 + 0.5;
88:       }
89:     });
90:   }
91: 
92:   function checkCollision() {
93:     for (const a of asteroids) {
94:       if (
95:         ship.x < a.x + a.w &&
96:         ship.x + ship.w > a.x &&
97:         ship.y < a.y + a.h &&
98:         ship.y + ship.h > a.y
99:       ) {
100:         return true;
101:       }
102:     }
103:     return false;
104:   }
105: 
106:   function drawScore() {
107:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
108:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
109:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}` , 10, 20);
110:   }
111: 
112:   function loop(timestamp) {
113:     const delta = timestamp - (loop.last ?? timestamp);
114:     loop.last = timestamp;
115: 
116:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
117:     drawStars();
118:     // Ship movement
119:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) ship.x -= ship.speed;
120:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) ship.x += ship.speed;
121:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x));
122:     drawShip();
123: 
124:     // Asteroids
125:     if (timestamp - lastAsteroid > asteroidInterval) {
126:       spawnAsteroid();
127:       lastAsteroid = timestamp;
128:     }
129:     updateAsteroids(delta);
130:     drawAsteroids();
131: 
132:     // Score
133:     score = (timestamp - startTime) / 1000;
134:     drawScore();
135: 
136:     // Collision
137:     if (checkCollision()) {
138:       gameOver = true;
139:     }
140: 
141:     if (!gameOver) {
142:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
143:     } else {
144:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
145:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);
146:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
147:       ctx.font = '48px monospace';
148:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
149:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width/2, height/2 - 20);
150:       ctx.font = '24px monospace';
151:       ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, width/2, height/2 + 20);
152:     }
153:   }
154: 
155:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
156: })();
